notes: v3.4 — faster thermal printing: shorter poll interval (default 800ms), persistent USB worker (compiles once instead of a PowerShell spawn + C# recompile per job), parallel printing across printers, and print timing logs.
_status: ARMED 2026-09-02 — self-update is ON. Every agent on v3.3+ auto-updates to 3.4.0 within ~6h (download -> verify sha256 -> swap -> restart). The binary served by GET /api/print-agent/download is print-agent/dist/AtithiSetuPrintAgent.exe, force-committed so the VPS serves it. To pause self-update again, set latest/sha256/url back to null. NOTE: prefer AGENT_EXE_PATH (VPS disk) or a CDN url for future releases to avoid committing the 57MB binary to git history.
